contexts.text: Onan involves what is iniquitous, or evil.
Onan was named by his mother... and therefore evil is signified by him.
She called his name Onan () = the quality of this evil.
Onan knew that the seed should not be for him () = aversion and hatred; (for) Onan = evil ... and evil is nothing else than aversion and hatred against the good and truth of the Church.

Onan, the second born of Judah, = the evil which is from the falsity of evil, in which that nation was afterwards... Evil from the falsity of evil is described by what Onan did, in that he did not want to give seed to his brother... This signified what is contrary to conjugial love...
Er and Onan died in the Land of Canaan () = that falsity and evil were extirpated.
